user.title: Select a Source Entity
user.description: Choose the existing entity whose actual state Entity Claim will control.

data_description.target_entity_id: Supported domains are cover, fan, light, and switch.

claims.title: Configure entity claims
claims.description:
Create one Claim Entity for each requester of `{target_entity_id}`.

{error_detail}

data_description.aggregation_policy: How ordered requests are combined. The available wording matches the Source capability.
data_description.control_policy: Always managed continuously enforces the aggregate. Allow manual override temporarily yields after a conflicting external Source change. Claim-scoped controls only an effect Entity Claim visibly caused and restores the original state when the last participating requester releases.
data_description.diagnostic_sensor_enabled: Adds one read-only diagnostic sensor for this source.

override.title: Configure Manual Override
override.description: `{target_entity_id}` will temporarily yield control after an external change conflicts with the aggregated desired state. Claims and aggregation continue updating during this period.

data_description.override_duration_minutes: Minutes to suppress reconciliation from the latest conflicting external Source change.

remove_confirm.title: Remove Entity Claim?
remove_confirm.description: `{target_entity_id}` will no longer be managed. All Claim Entities and the diagnostic sensor created by this configuration will be removed. The Source Entity will not be deleted.

options.authoritative: Always managed — continuously enforce the aggregated state
options.override: Allow manual override — temporarily yield to conflicting external changes
options.scoped: Claim-scoped — restore only an effect Entity Claim visibly created

options.any: ANY — turn on when any requester requires it
options.all: ALL — turn off when any requester requires it

options.any: ANY — use the highest requested brightness
options.all: ALL — use the lowest mutually accepted brightness
